title: MEMOIR: A Training-Free Memory Lifecycle for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents require memory systems that preserve useful information across sessions and retrieve it when needed. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: memories are written prospectively with static importance scores that are never revised after use. This creates two coupled failure modes: consolidation can silently destroy evidence that future queries require, while retrieval continues to favor stale memories. We propose MEMOIR (Memory Evidence via Merge-certified, Online Importance Revision), a training-free memory lifecycle that unifies judge-gated consolidation with retrospective attribution. Before compressing memory, screening gates test whether answer-relevant evidence is preserved. After each query, attribution estimates which retrieved memories supported the answer and updates their retrieval priority. translated_title: MEMOIR：一种面向长程 LLM 智能体的免训练记忆生命周期
translated_abstract: 长程 LLM 智能体需要这样的记忆系统：能够在多个会话之间保存有用信息，并在需要时将其检索出来。现有系统将这些视为相互分离的问题：记忆被预先写入时带有静态的重要性分数，且在使用后从不修订。这导致了两个相互耦合的失败模式：记忆整合可能会悄悄破坏未来查询所需的证据，而检索则持续偏向陈旧的记忆。我们提出 MEMOIR（通过合并认证的在线重要性修订实现记忆证据），这是一种免训练的记忆生命周期，它将“由判别器把关的整合”与“回溯性归因”统一起来。在压缩记忆之前，筛选门会检验与答案相关的证据是否得到保留。在每次查询之后，归因机制会估计哪些被检索到的记忆支撑了答案，并据此更新它们的检索优先级。此外，UCB 风格的探索奖励会额外鼓励检索曝光不足的记忆，减少……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MEMOIR 提出了一种免训练的记忆生命周期，通过压缩前的证据保全筛选门与查询后的回溯性归因动态修订记忆的重要性，解决了长程 LLM 智能体中记忆整合破坏关键证据与检索偏向陈旧记忆这两个相互耦合的失败模式。
en_tdlr: MEMOIR is a training-free memory lifecycle that unifies judge-gated consolidation with retrospective attribution to dynamically revise memory importance, addressing the coupled failure modes where consolidation silently destroys evidence needed by future queries and retrieval keeps favoring stale memories in long-horizon LLM agents.
